title: Velo Client 0.9.0
summary: The Afterlife Halloween wings, new cosmetics without updating, your cosmetics on the Home screen, a better Redstone Replace, and fixes for disappearing wings and the Session Auto-Fixer.

blocks.text: 0.9.0 brings the **Afterlife** Halloween wings (they get their own post), makes new cosmetics show up **without an update**, and fixes two things that have been bugging you.

Wings and capes now come from the Velo server. When a new pair or cape drops, it appears in the Store right away - in the game and in the launcher - and its model and textures download in the background. Limited drops show how many days they have left.

The **Cosmetics** page has a new **Wings** tab: see every pair you own on your own skin, equip one, and tune **size**, **height**, **distance**, **spread**, **flap speed** and **flap strength** with a live 3D preview. The game picks your choice up the next time it starts.

blocks.caption: Your wings and their settings, right in the launcher.

blocks.text: Your cosmetics on the Home screen
The player on the launcher's Home screen now wears what you have equipped - cape, wings and aura - and turns slowly so you can see the back too.

items: **Keep direction** - blocks keep pointing the same way even when the two blocks store it differently: a **crafter** becomes a **dispenser** facing the same way, logs and chains keep their axis, signs and heads their rotation.
**Turn** - replace and rotate in one go: 90° right, 180°, 90° left or the opposite way.
**Chance** - replace only a share of the blocks, picked at random (great for mixing textures).
**Several blocks at once** - e.g. `stone, andesite, cobblestone`.

blocks.text: **Velo+** is our new monthly subscription - and it keeps Velo Client going. It includes:

items: **The Velo+ badge** - your logo with a red plus behind it, next to your name for every Velo player (chat, tab list, above your head).
**VIP role** in our Discord - given automatically once you've linked your Discord, taken away again when Velo+ ends.
**Velo Coins every month** to spend on wings, capes and auras.

**The Velo Client Addons** - Cinematic Camera, Fly Boat, Auto Eat, Storage Finder, Entity Finder, Auto Tunnel Miner, Ender Chest Farmer, Auto Excavator and Sound Radar. They're now exclusive to Velo+ and no longer on GitHub; the launcher installs and updates them for you.

blocks.text: Find it in the **Velo+** tab of the Store, in the launcher and in the game.

The **Velo Neon** cape isn't sold in the Store - you get it by joining our **Discord** and linking your account. In the Store's **Capes** tab (launcher) or with the **Link Discord** button (in-game Store) you get a short code; type `/link` and the code in our Discord and the cape is yours.

Cosmetics, Store, News and Home used to freeze while capes decoded on the main thread (and sometimes ran out of memory). Pages now open instantly with a small spinner and the previews fill in after; news shows straight away from the last visit and updates in the background; cards animate lighter. Cape previews use a fraction of the memory.

items: **Wings showed as equipped but weren't on your player** after starting the game until you re-equipped them - they're there right away now.

**Session Auto-Fixer** could stay on "Fixing session..." forever for some accounts. The session was actually refreshed, but switching to it failed - that's fixed, and if anything ever goes wrong the button tells you instead of getting stuck.
The launcher's sidebar now highlights **Cosmetics** while you're on it.
A profile you'd used to join a server **disappeared from the Home list** as a plain "just play" entry - it's always there now.
The **News** page could end up wider than the window (scrolling sideways) until you resized it a few times - images in posts now fit the window right away.
Things the Velo team gives you show up in **Cosmetics** and the **Store** right away, without restarting the launcher.
Wings and auras are no longer cut off on the **Home** screen.
